extracted.name: Dry Fried Cornmeal Patties
extracted.description: These can be cooked in many ways, fried in oil, dry Fried, baked, deep fried, and boiled as dumplings.

instruction_lines: Add the ingredients form a dough it will be sticky. Dust with flour and form patties.
